summary: The CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll is a part of the HSPnet UserControls for Enrollment that handles the display and management of criminal records checks for student enrollments. It involves validation, data binding, and update operations on a web UI grid.
purpose: To manage the display, sorting, editing, and saving of criminal records check data for enrollments within a web application, ensuring that the data can be viewed and edited by authorized users.

fields.name: gridDataEdit
fields.description: Displays criminal records check data for editing.

fields.name: dsCRC
fields.description: Data source for criminal records check data.

fields.name: ScriptMgr
fields.description: Manages client-side script for Web Forms.

fields.name: ShowGrad
fields.description: Indicates whether to show graduated records.

fields.name: ShowInactive
fields.description: Indicates whether to show inactive records.

fields.name: ShowWaived
fields.description: Indicates whether to show waived records.

fields.name: blnReadOnly
fields.description: Indicates if the data is read-only.

fields.name: blnStudentMaint
fields.description: Indicates if the student maintenance mode is active.

workflows.name: Data Binding and Validation
steps: Bind data to gridDataEdit if not in async postback.
Register JavaScript variables for client-side use.
Cancel data source selection if no user session.
Setup object data source inputs based on session and filters.

workflows.name: Row Command Execution
steps: Execute command based on command name.
Redirect based on command execution and warnings.

workflows.name: Row Data Binding
steps: Bind dropdown for CRCStatus based on data item.
Hide buttons based on read-only status and row type.

validations: Ensure UserSession is valid before data operations.
Grid controls hide save buttons when in add or single edit mode.
conditions: Check if EnrollmentID is greater than 0 to set row to edit state.
Hide buttons based on blnReadOnly and number of rows.
system_behavior: GridView binds data during asynchronous and non-asynchronous postbacks.
JavaScript variables are registered based on postback type.
dependencies: Uses HSPnet session to manage user-specific operations.
Relies on grid data binding and dropdown data sources.
exceptions: Data source selection is cancelled if user session is null.
